title: Oxygen Not Included
notes: Pilot for native Linux build 744825, save 7.38, base game or Spaced Out, English UI. The prepared save determines DLC mode and native standard-Survival defaults. Isolated cycle-zero three-duplicant prepared save. Native pause is available through ordinary keyboard input; inference and pauses consume wall time. Evidence comes only from native saves, so unsaved progress is not scored. Building presence does not prove operation or colony survival. Live Trials do not pause automatically. Both execution modes use a bounded X11 presentation wait after released input, charged to the original deadline. Frozen Trials additionally use identity-checked process suspension. No engine input or evaluator state is exposed to the agent. The owner selected standard Survival on Terra for the staged early-colony development evaluation, rather than maximum custom difficulty. The fixed native preset and published base-game start preserve reproducibility while testing basic infrastructure, actual production and research. The owner explicitly accepted this continuous-development interpretation and the five sequential 20-point stages on 2026-10-30. It evaluates staged colony development rather than prerequisites on every possible winning route. The completed thinking-high live and frozen 0.7.5 calibration Trials both scored 0/100; this does not establish positive acceptance of every stage. On 2026-10-31 the owner requested development-v2: foundation requires one new completed bed and one new completed toilet, without handwashing; all remaining stages are unchanged. Prior maintainer scope acceptance and completed calibration refer to v1; new v2 calibration and acceptance remain pending.
introduction: Oxygen Not Included is a real-time colony-management game. Duplicants carry out reachable queued jobs according to native priorities while consuming resources. The standard Survival prepared start uses the base game, Terra and three duplicants at cycle zero. Colony development includes construction, resource production, research and space exploration. The game has native pause and speed controls.
controls: Use left click to select objects and interface buttons, right click or Escape to cancel, and hover to inspect tooltips. Drag with the left button to apply an active area tool across multiple tiles. G selects Dig. WASD pans the camera; the wheel zooms. Space toggles native pause and Tab cycles through the three simulation speeds. Tool and menu state can change key behavior.
